               **
               ** Visibility       :   Static

               static void I2c_HwInit(uint8 I2c_unit_index)
               {
                   I2c_RegisterPtrType i2c_unit; /* i2c register structure */
2 0     (T)    I2c_HwInit
2 1     (T)(F)   if(4U > I2c_unit_index)
                   {
2 2      *         i2c_unit = I2c_Config[I2c_unit_index].BaseAddress; /* getting base address from configuration */
2 3      *         i2c_unit->CON_reg.CON_field.u1I2C_EN = 0x00U;
                       /* i2c controller own address setting - required when we are activting as slave */
2 4      *         i2c_unit->OA_reg.OA_field.u10OA = 0x00U;
                       /* configuring I2C in normal mode (0) for STB mode (1) */
2 5      *         i2c_unit->CON_reg.CON_field.u1STB = 0x00U;
                       /* Slave Address setting 7-bit slave addressing */
2 6      *         i2c_unit->CON_reg.CON_field.u1XSA = 0x00U; /* 7-bit addressing selection (0) and (1) for 10-bit addressing - 7-bit only supported */
                       /* Clear TX FIFO*/
2 7      *         i2c_unit->BUF_reg.BUF_field.u1TXFIFO_CLR = 0x01U;
2 8      *         i2c_unit->BUF_reg.BUF_field.u1TXFIFO_CLR = 0x00U;
                       /* Clear RX FIFO*/
2 9      *         i2c_unit->BUF_reg.BUF_field.u1RXFIFO_CLR = 0x01U;
2 10     *         i2c_unit->BUF_reg.BUF_field.u1RXFIFO_CLR = 0x00U;
                       /* Noise filter settings - are controlled internally */
                       /*Clear Interrupt requests*/
2 11     *         i2c_unit->IRQENABLE_SET_reg.u32Register = 0x00U;
2 12     *         i2c_unit->IRQENABLE_CLR_reg.u32Register = ((uint32) 0x7FFFU);
2 13     *         i2c_unit->IRQSTATUS_RAW_reg.u32Register = 0x00U;
                       /* clear the interrupts - all is done in this register */
2 14     *         i2c_unit->IRQSTATUS_reg.u32Register = ((uint32) 0x7FFFU);
                   }
               }

               **

               Std_ReturnType I2c_AsyncTransmit(I2c_SequenceType Sequence)

10 1     *       ret_val = (0x01U);
10 2     *       I2c_RegisterPtrType i2c_unit= ((void *)0);
10 3     *       uint8 HwUnitIndex = 0u;
10 4    (T)(F)   if(4U > Sequence)
                   {
10 5     *         HwUnitIndex = I2c_ChannelConfig[Sequence].HwUnit;
10 6    (T)(F)     if(4U > HwUnitIndex)
                       {
10 7     *           i2c_unit = I2c_Config[HwUnitIndex].BaseAddress;
10 8    (T)(F)       if(I2c_DrvStatus.Status[HwUnitIndex] != 0U)
                           {
10 9    (T)(F)         if((I2c_Config[I2c_ChannelConfig[Sequence].HwUnit].I2C_Mode & 0x02uL) != 0U )
                               {
                                   /* Check whether the bus is busy due to this Micro as Master */
10 10   (T)(F)           if(I2c_HwInfo[I2c_ChannelConfig[Sequence].HwUnit].HwStatus != 3U)
                                   {
                                       /* check if bus is not busy - the whole i2c network */
10 11   (T)(F)             if(0x00U == i2c_unit->IRQSTATUS_RAW_reg.IRQSTATUS_RAW_field.u1BB)
                                       {
10 12    *                   ret_val = (0x00U);
10 13   (T)(F)               if((I2c_ChannelInfo[Sequence].TxLength > 0U) || (I2c_ChannelInfo[Sequence].RxLength > 0U))
                                           {
10 14    *                     I2c_EnterCriticalSection();
                                               /* Channel Status to BUSY */
10 15    *                     I2c_ChannelInfo[Sequence].Result = 8U;
                                               /* Update the timeout for the sequence */
10 16    *                     I2c_HwInfo[I2c_ChannelConfig[Sequence].HwUnit].TimeoutCount = 200U;
                                               /* Hw Unit Status to BUSY */
10 17    *                     I2c_HwInfo[I2c_ChannelConfig[Sequence].HwUnit].HwStatus = 3U;
                                               /* update the current sequence to hw unit structure */
10 18    *                     I2c_HwInfo[I2c_ChannelConfig[Sequence].HwUnit].CurrentSeq = Sequence;
10 19    *                     I2c_HwInfo[I2c_ChannelConfig[Sequence].HwUnit].IsStopWait = (0U);
10 20    *                     I2c_HwInfo[I2c_ChannelConfig[Sequence].HwUnit].CurrentPriority = I2c_ChannelConfig[Sequence].SeqPriority;
                                               /* Driver Status to BUSY */
10 21    *                     I2c_DrvStatus.Status[HwUnitIndex] = 3U;
10 22    *                     I2c_InternalState[HwUnitIndex] = 3U;
10 23    *                     I2c_ExitCriticalSection();
                                               /* Start Transfer for the above Set Sequence */
10 24    *                     I2c_StartTransfer(Sequence);
                                           }
                                       }
                                       else /* Bus Is Busy for the the whole i2c network - this is checked when other i2c modules other than the R5 core i2c */
                                       {
10 25   (T)(F)               if(I2c_BusBusyState[Sequence].WholeNetworkStatus != 3U)
                                           {
10 26    *                     ret_val = (0x01U);
10 27    *                     I2c_BusBusyState[Sequence].WholeNetworkStatus = 3U;
10 28    *                     I2c_BusBusyState[Sequence].BusBusyTimeout = 200u;
                                               /* Send notification to Application on the bus busy with retry mechanism status */
10 29   (T)(F)                 if(I2c_ChannelConfig[Sequence].I2C_EndNotificationCallback != ((void *)0))
                                               {
                                                   /* Sequence End Callback Notfication */
10 30    *                       I2c_ChannelConfig[Sequence].I2C_EndNotificationCallback(Sequence, 3U, 5U);
                                               }
                                           }
                                           else
                                           {
                                               /* Send notification to Application on the bus busy with cancel status of seq */
10 31   (T)(F)                 if(I2c_ChannelConfig[Sequence].I2C_EndNotificationCallback != ((void *)0))
                                               {
                                                   /* Sequence End Callback Notfication */
10 32    *                       I2c_ChannelConfig[Sequence].I2C_EndNotificationCallback(Sequence, 3U, 4U);
                                               }
10 33    *                     I2c_EnterCriticalSection();
10 34    *                     I2c_ChannelInfo[Sequence].Result = 4U;
10 35    *                     I2c_ExitCriticalSection();
                                           }
                                       }
                                   }
                                   else /* If the internal status of our Master is busy then */
                                   {
                                       /* check if sequence is not in queue already */
10 36   (T)(F)             if(I2c_ChannelInfo[Sequence].IsQueued != (1U))
                                       {
                                           /* add to queue and wait for the next cycle to address it */
10 37    *                   I2c_EnterCriticalSection();
                                           /* Set Queue for the sequence */
10 38    *                   I2c_ChannelInfo[Sequence].IsQueued = (1U);
10 39    *                   I2c_ChannelInfo[Sequence].Result = 2U;
10 40    *                   I2c_ExitCriticalSection();
10 41    *                   ret_val = (0x00U);
                                       }
                                       /* sequence is in queue already */
                                       else
                                       {
                                           /* reject status of the seq and notify callback to application shows that already in queue */
10 42   (T)(F)               if(I2c_ChannelConfig[Sequence].I2C_EndNotificationCallback != ((void *)0))
                                           {
                                               /* Sequence End Callback Notfication */
10 43    *                     I2c_ChannelConfig[Sequence].I2C_EndNotificationCallback(Sequence, 3U, 6U);
                                           }
                                       }
                                   }
                               }
                           }
                       }
                   }
10 44    *       return ret_val;
               }
